description: This file defines the Beta class for statistical beta distribution calculations, including distribution, inverse, and incomplete beta functions, with auxiliary mathematical functions.

classes.name: Beta
classes.description: Provides static methods to compute the beta distribution, its inverse, and related functions.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Returns the value of the beta distribution function at a given point or array of points.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Returns the inverse (quantile) of the beta distribution for a given probability.

methods.name: calculateInverse
methods.description: Performs a binary search to find the distribution value corresponding to a given probability.

methods.name: incompleteBeta
methods.description: Calculates the incomplete beta function, used internally by other methods.

methods.name: logBeta
methods.description: Computes the natural logarithm of the beta function, with caching for efficiency.

methods.name: betaFraction
methods.description: Evaluates the continued fraction part of the incomplete beta function.
